description: Implement a weight residency cache in StreamingMatMul to eliminate repeated tensor acquisition. B010 counters are preserved to prove the cache changed behavior.
hypothesis: Caching dequantized weight tensors in memory after first load will reduce bytes read from 8,971 MB toward ~2,019 MB (model size), reduce map calls from 74,693 toward ~197, and reduce prefill wall time. The ~2,019 MB target is a hypothesis, not a certification criterion.
b010_counters_purpose: B010 counters prove the cache actually changed behavior. They must NOT be removed.
design_constraints: Cache must not break B008/B009 numerical equivalence
Cache must not increase memory beyond available RAM
Cache invalidation strategy needed for multi-model scenarios
Cache should be opt-in (env var or config flag) for A/B testing
B010 profiling counters must remain active

b011_cache_implementation.description: Weight residency cache implemented in StreamingMatMul

b011_residency_improvement.description: Hit rate 79.96%, 786 hits, maps reduced from 74693 to 197

b011_performance_measurement.description: Prefill 15501ms, acquisition 0ms, compute 14522ms — regression reported (+25.2% prefill). Performance benefit NOT YET DEMONSTRATED for this benchmark.

b011_decode_preservation.description: T==1 decode produces token 108, same as B008

notes: B011 is a controlled experiment, not a guaranteed optimization
B010 establishes the acquisition pathology; B011 tests whether residency reuse eliminates it
The ~2,019 MB bytes-read target is a hypothesis, not a pass/fail threshold
Actual results depend on cache granularity, mapping alignment, and view sharing
